name: Quick Pro UR:ONE
why_interesting: A lightweight road build pairing a 629 g claimed frame with Dura-Ace Di2 and a current official global price.
missing: Dated mainland-China RMB checkout observation and purchase route
Mainland delivery, duties, returns, and warranty-handling confirmation
source_note: The current exact global page retains the US$6,899 price, 629 g size-M frame and qualitative stiffness/control claim. It still publishes no complete-bike weight or mainland CNY checkout amount; the 6.5 kg owner build is not generalized.

facts.complete_weight_status: No official complete-bike weight found after 50 registered source areas; one 6.5 kg owner build is configuration-specific
facts.price_status: Current US$6,899 global price only; no attributable mainland CNY checkout amount after 50 registered areas
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer says the exact UR:ONE preserves stiffness and control at low weight and cites Silverstone validation; qualitative claim without a public stiffness protocol

support_note: Official support page states a five-year frameset warranty for the original purchaser, one-year Shimano/SRAM coverage on complete bikes, mostly assembled delivery, and typical standard-bike delivery around three weeks; mainland-China service and delivery are not confirmed.
